title: Effect of MgSO4 + 1h30 [Mg 1h30 a]

growth_protocol_ch1: Naval Medical Resarch Institute (NMRI)-mice housed in our laboratory. Day of birth was noted 1.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA from brain hemisphere (deleted of olfactory bulb and sectionned anterior to colliculus) were extracted using Nucleospin RNA plus kit (Ref 740984-250; Macherey-Nagel) following manufacturer's instructions. label_protocol_ch1: Agilent Low input QuickAmp Labeling kit was used according to the manufacturer instructions (catalog number 5190-2306) with 100ng  of total starting RNA.
